pages.description: Minutes away from Miami International Airport, the Pullman Miami Airport Hotel features spacious guestrooms with free WiFi and offers a courtesy airport shuttle.
pages.text:
Miami Airport Hotels - Pullman Miami
Pullman Miami Airport - Luxury hotel
Experience Miami lifestyle and design in our chic airport Hotel
Pullman Miami Airport is an oasis in the middle of the Waterford business park with easy access to the very best of Miami. 3.3 miles from Miami Airport and minutes from Brickell City Centre, Midtown, Downtown Miami, Port of Miami, Miami Beach, Downtown Doral, and Doral City Center.
The hotel features Outdoor Pool, Bar, Business Center, and Shuttle Services.
The hotel offers spacious guest rooms and suites, free wi-fi, on-site parking, and full-service dining.
With over 11,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor meeting space, our Miami conference hotel offers the perfect location for your next meeting.

Frequently Asked Questions – Pullman Miami Airport Rooms and Suites
What is the check in time at the Pullman Miami Airport?
Check in is at 3pm local hotel time at Pullman Miami Airport (local hotel time).
What time is check out at the Pullman Hotel Miami?
Check out time is 11am local hotel time at the Pullman Miami Airport.
Is Wi-Fi included at Pullman Miami Airport?
Yes. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is included for all registered guests at Pullman Miami Airport and is available in guestrooms and public areas throughout the hotel.
Does the Pullman Hotel Miami Airport allow Pets?
Yes! The the hotel allows pets 30lbs and under. There is a fee of $35 USD per day. plus $250.00 authorization for incidentals. Please note that pets may not be left unattended in Guestrooms.

Miami Airport Hotel - Pullman Miami Airport -
Pullman Miami Airport - Luxury hotel - Location
Pullman Miami Airport is an oasis in the middle of the Waterford business park with easy access to the best attractions Miami has to offer. Visit nearby Coral Gables and Viscaya Gardens or catch the latest Broadway show at Adrienne Arscht Performing Arts Center. Must-see sports are minutes from the hotel at Hard Rock Stadium or Marlins Park. 3.3 miles from Miami Airport with free shuttle service and minutes from Brickell City Centre, Downtown Miami, Port of Miami, and beaches.
